 Assets
 Notice of Material Change
Date of change: 2026/05/01
I am no longer President and Secretary of the corporation Dr Paul C. Hébert Inc., an inactive professional corporation located in Gatineau, Quebec, in which I hold a controlling interest.
 Copyright on a few scientific articles
 Nominal interest in University of Ottawa Medical Associates/Médecins Associés de l’Université d’Ottawa, a partnership located in Ottawa, Ontario comprised of physicians with academic appointments to the University of Ottawa.
 Outside Activities
 Pursuant to subsection 15(1.1) of the Conflict of Interest Act, I will continue to practice as a voluntary physician for four weeks per year at Bruyère Continuing Care to retain my license, professional qualifications and technical proficiencies, as long as the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner is of the opinion that doing so is not incompatible with my official duties.
 Agreed Compliance Measures
 Conflict of interest screens are preventive compliance measures, agreed upon pursuant to section 29 of the Conflict of Interest Act (Act) by public office holders and the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, to assist them in avoiding conflicts of interest. Screens also seek to minimize the possibility of conflicts arising between the public duties of the public office holders and their private interests or those of their relatives and friends. 
The Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and I have agreed that a conflict of interest screen is an appropriate compliance measure for me, aimed at preventing any opportunity, while I exercise my official powers, duties and functions as a reporting public office holder, to further the private interests or to give preferential treatment to the following entities:
- Bruyère Health and its Research Institute
- University of Ottawa 
- Université de Montréal’s affiliated hospital research centre.
Accordingly, I have agreed to recuse myself from any discussion or decision in relation to these entities or their representatives. I understand that recusal means I must remove myself from the room, physically or virtually as the case may be. I also agree not to have any communication with government officials in relation to any matter or decision-making processes which I or the screen administrator know or reasonably should know to affect the private interests of these entities. 
This screen is co-administered by the Executive Vice-President and the Vice-President, Research – Programs of the Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR) to ensure that I am neither made aware of nor participate in any official matters or decision-making processes involving the private interests of these entities. I will participate in decisions or matters of general application and those that may affect the private interests of these entities as members of a broad class of persons unless those interests are disproportionate to the other members of the class. 
The Minister of Health as well as the members of the Governing Council, the Executive Management, the Scientific Directors and staff members of the CIHR have been informed in writing about this conflict of interest screen. 
I have undertaken to inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner at the earliest opportunity of all changes of which I become aware that relate to or should form part of the above list of matters caught by this screen. 
In the event that I am made aware of a matter forming part of this screen or any such matter comes before me, I am required under section 21 of the Act to recuse myself from that matter. I must so inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and, where appropriate, make a public declaration of recusal pursuant to subsection 25(1) of the Act. 
 Recusal

— Page 2 —
In the exercise of my official duties as President of the Canadian Institutes of Health Research, I recused myself on December 10, 2025 from a discussion and decision regarding the granting of research funds for clinical trials on social prescribing, long-term care and palliative care, in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and my private interests as well as those of Bruyère Health Research Institute.
